blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas in Metro Manila and Rizal will experience water service interruptions beginning Thursday, Oct. 22, as Maynilad Water Services Inc. and Manila Water Co. conduct maintenance and service improvement activities. Maynilad said the maintenance activities aim to keep its water distribution system “safe, reliable and in good condition.” READ: Approval of national water management bill pushed amid El Niño threat “These works usually affect only small areas and are done during off-peak hours to minimize impact on our customers,” its advisory said. “We advise affected customers to store enough water ahead of the scheduled interruption.
